<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" status="finalized" xml:id="ex10012024-07-31-15-295">'di la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4294">khyung po</rs> na re | rnaM thar sgoM gsuM shes ba ni gnyen po cig yin la | 'dis spang bya gsuM spong ngo || °°° shes <expan>la sogs</expan> pa spong ba ni gnyen po gsuM yin la de gsuM gyis spang bya cig spong zhing | lhag ma rnaMs gnyen po re res spang bya re re spong zhes zer ro || 
               
            de ltar ni ma yin gyi | <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3792">dags po</rs><note type="editorial">"dags po" could also be Dwags po lha rje (ID:4189), but the latter is mentioned in the same text as "lha rje".</note> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5611">'buM pa</rs> na re</note> gnyen po re res <pb n="85a"/><lb n="85a1"/> spang bya re re rim pa bzin spong ba yin pas °°°i°o°i° ni phung po lnga la ngo bor gyur pa'aM byin gyis rlob pa po'i bdag med pa yin pas | de shes pas bdag du 'dzin pa spong ste | de gnyis rnaM pa 'gal pa yin pa'i phyir ro ||</seg></TEI>
